data.selection: Complete official header census; fixed ID hash order; known IDs/waveforms excluded; unsupported or unrecognized codes excluded; no predictions

optimization.sampling: One shuffled visit per record per epoch
optimization.pathology_loss: Masked stable BCE; Primary5 weights 2, other labels 1; no positive class weighting
optimization.progression: Last two existing blocks first 4 epochs; all five existing blocks thereafter; frozen BN and quality/biometrics parameters
optimization.pcgrad: Symmetric two-task negative-dot projection on shared backbone only; head-own gradients unchanged; auxiliary preservation added without projection; sum scaling matches unprojected loss

selection.threshold_fit: 2027 unchanged native fold-9 records; fixed grid 0.05..0.95, ties higher

control: Frozen phase10 joint model; identical validation/calibration; preserved alongside every candidate
execution: CEDIA Slurm GPU; deterministic algorithms; exact selected refits before followup labels open
